title: RI-06 (cand-heart): the Junction Heart — the rail yard's claim as the first boss: two feeder cabinets, a 90 s commissioning, three reinforcement packets, the hour bot rifle off (candidate layer beside the benchmark)
setup: river city, seeds 3/4/5, the candidate Heart layer (candidates.ts) with economy=true so claims are paid; the hour bot on the physical claim path, hand-mining copper shortfalls and carrying patrol supplies, rifle off, 75 min; the replay, the 30:00 save, the ledger; E-hour's unchanged economy=false benchmark beside it; both configuration hashes in each seed's data

sections.title: E-heart-timeline: the encounter's moments (mm:ss) — the hour bot on the physical claim path, the candidate layer on, rifle off, river city
sections.note: packet-N: the reinforcement packet requested at N % of the first attempt that crossed it; heart-retry: a Start after an interruption.

sections.title: E-heart-end: the encounter and the hour's end at 75:00
rows: Junction Heart · destroyed after 1 attempt(s) · the rail yard is operational

sections.title: E-heart-cabinets: the two feeder cabinets — the tile, the approach they face, the emergence point the packets use, what reached them
E-heart-replay: the logged hour replayed on a fresh city with the layer — the same state hash and Heart record; the heart / project events counted every tick
E-heart-save: the replay saved at 30:00 (save.ts makeSave → JSON → loadState), both copies replayed to 75:00 (goalcheck.ts)
E-heart-ledger: resource conservation (ledger.ts) at the hour's end — opening + sources → held + sinks (the cabinets' materials as committed stock, then spent)
E-heart-beside: the candidate layer against E-hour's benchmark configuration (no Heart), the same seed and clock, rifle off
